deal_value.notes: Announced Sep 15, 2021 as a strategic growth investment; neither investment amount, stake percentage, nor valuation disclosed (Houlihan Lokey advised Odessa; Raymond James advised THL).

calculable.caveats: No deal value public. Only unverified data-vendor estimates exist for Odessa financials (e.g. Getlatka's '$262.6M ARR / $787.8M valuation' for 2024) - not credible sources and post-date the deal, so nothing can be computed.
